description: This file contains UI smoke tests for the onboarding view within a macOS application related to openclaw. It defines a test suite with several test functions that verify UI behavior, page order logic, and remote gateway selection handling.

classes.name: OnboardingViewSmokeTests
classes.description: A test suite struct that contains smoke tests for onboarding view behavior and logic.

methods.name: `onboarding view builds body`
methods.description: Tests that the onboarding view's body property can be instantiated without errors.

methods.name: `page order omits workspace and identity steps`
methods.description: Verifies that certain steps are omitted from the onboarding page order based on specific conditions.

methods.name: `page order omits onboarding chat when identity known`
methods.description: Checks that onboarding chat page is omitted if the user's identity is already known.

methods.name: `select remote gateway clears stale ssh target when endpoint unresolved`
methods.description: Ensures that selecting a remote gateway resets the remote target when the gateway's endpoint is unresolved.
